primary.parents: All available eligible fresh parents in source order
primary.comparison: Exactly matched raw physical cost including one-time9660 training calls
primary.observable: Mean paired restrained-potential difference learned minus site, averaged across the two replicas within each parent
primary.uncertainty: 2000 paired parent-cluster bootstrap draws,95 percent percentile interval

secondary: Other declared query budgets and cohort prefixes, reference-graph first hits excluding initially-reference parents, terminal graph occupancy, structural diversity, wall time and failures. Treat these as descriptive; do not select a favorable secondary result to replace a failed primary comparison.
interpretation: A lower primary mean with interval below zero supports a finite-cost energy benefit on this composition. It does not establish equilibrium sampling, independent-composition transfer, quantum chemical validity, or superiority to all learned generators.
